meta.name: board-memo
meta.description: Draft a board or executive summary of an engagement using outcomes, risks and investment decisions. Use when the sponsor needs to brief senior leadership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目成果、风险与投入决策整理成一份给高层看的简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目结束后要向管理层或投资人总结成果与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn engagement outcomes, risks, and investment decisions into a board-ready summary
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must brief senior leadership on results and risks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按技能内的任务上下文约定与方法，起草一份面向董事会或高管的项目总结，涵盖成果、风险与投资决策。它直接基于你提供的上下文工作，不需要绑定项目文件夹。
howto.when: 当赞助人需要向高层领导汇报时触发。若由 @fde 调用，会复用其当前已清理的信息包和范围，不重新做设置或发现。

say.text: 根据这些材料起草一份董事会级别的项目总结
say.note: 产出含成果、风险与投资决策的总结

say.text: 赞助人要向高管汇报，帮我写这份摘要
say.note: 按技能方法生成高管摘要

say.text: 把这次的成果、风险和投资决策整理成董事会简报
say.note: 保留未知项，区分实施与验收

howto.what_en: Claude drafts a board or executive summary of an engagement from the context you supply, covering outcomes, risks and investment decisions. It works standalone, without an engagement folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the sponsor needs to brief senior leadership. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Draft a board-level summary of this engagement from these materials
say_en.note: Summary covers outcomes, risks and investment decisions

say_en.text: The sponsor needs to brief executives; draft that summary for me
say_en.note: Generates an executive summary with the skill's method

say_en.text: Turn the outcomes, risks and investment decisions into a board memo
say_en.note: Keeps unknowns, separates rollout from acceptance
